_scoring.note: counts below cover the 11 sample laws plus the 2 calibration laws (13 laws)

_classes.name: Infinitive list items under a mandatory 'shall have the following powers and duties' lead-in stored as powers (recurrence of the Oct 17 fix)
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and kind_model=='duty' and re.match(r'^\s*(\(?\w{1,4}[.)]\s*)?[Tt]o [a-z]+', quote) (11 of the 18 also carry kind_adjusted=='grant_only')

_classes.name: Stated period after an undated event (session adjournment etc.) stored as on_effective_date with the deadline text lost
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' and re.search(r'\b(within|not later than|no later than|on or before)\s+[\w\-]+\s*(\(\d+\)\s*)?(days?|months?|years?)\s+(after|following|of)\s+(?!(the )?(effective date|date (on which )?(this|it) (act )?shall have become|this act))', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: Earlier chapter's sunset-year extension amended inside the law left with no record
_classes.rule: packet LAW TEXT, excluding the law's own last '§ N. This act shall take effect' paragraph, matches r'(expire|deemed repealed)[^{}\[\]]{0,120}\[[^\]]{0,40}\d{4}\]\s*\{\{[^}]{0,40}\d{4}\}\}' and the law has stored records but none whose quote matches /repeal|expire/i (counts laws, of 679 packet laws with such an amendment)

_classes.name: duplicate_provision gate keeps the shorter quote and drops the fuller record, losing a clause (here the biannual meeting duty)
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='duplicate_provision' whose quote is >15 chars longer than and contains the kept record's quote (kept id from reason 'overlaps <id>')

_classes.name: extends_existing wrong: list item added to an existing list held false; wholly new form power held true
_classes.rule: no clean mechanical rule; rescued_imperative_item and extends_existing==False matches 473 records, mostly legitimate
